## What a caller can do after this

## Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] Macro added or renamed: grammar, snippet, `tests/editor.rs`, docs, and a test
- [ ] User-visible change noted under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md
